items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, I think so too. Somebody once said that his open tone was not good.

ctx.x: I don't remember what it was, but I had a plunger. 2). But you see, Fats couldn't do anything else except growl and he was, that's all he could do.
I think that was the, wasn't that really somewhat the case with Bubber Miley?
